purpose: Trigger evaluation set for the skill description. 20 queries: 10 should-trigger, 10 near-miss should-not-trigger. Split is 60/40 train/validation, fixed across description iterations.

method.selection: Choose the description iteration by VALIDATION score, not train score.
method.detection: In Claude Code, the Skill tool call is visible in JSON output: jq 'any(.messages[].content[]; .type=="tool_use" and .name=="Skill")'

notes: Near-miss negatives deliberately share keywords with the positives.
Every should-trigger query is a substantive multi-step task; a simple one-step request will not trigger any skill, so including such queries would measure nothing.
The negatives are near-misses, not random unrelated work.

queries.query: Research how the EU AI Act enforcement timeline has changed in the last six months and give me a sourced briefing I can send to my team.
queries.why: Explicit research request needing current, cited, multi-source information.

queries.query: Is it true that Postgres 18 dropped support for MD5 passwords? I need to be able to check this before I tell our security team.
queries.why: Fact verification against a current release, needs a live primary source.

queries.query: What is the current stable version of Node.js, and what are the two most recent security releases in that line?
queries.why: Version and security-release question; memory would be stale.

queries.query: Compare Vite 6 and Vite 7 for a mid-sized React monorepo, and tell me which one people are actually migrating to and why.
queries.why: Comparison plus community sentiment; needs current sources.

queries.query: Find out who won the latest Rust compiler team survey and what the top complaint was.
queries.why: Current event with a specific answer; strongly time-sensitive.

queries.query: I need to know what the GDPR penalties actually are for a data breach under 1M euros, from the primary legal text rather than a blog post.
queries.why: Legal fact, needs primary source, benefits from tool selection policy.

queries.query: What changed in the v3 to v4 migration of the library I am using, and what should I change in my code?
queries.why: Migration guide research; a paraphrase from memory is exactly the failure mode.

queries.query: Gather the top five papers from the last year on speculative decoding and summarize what they actually found, with citations.
queries.why: Academic literature search; arxiv/papers tool applies.

queries.query: Check whether the startup I am considering has actually shipped anything in the last year, and pull their pricing page figures for me.
queries.why: Live pricing and activity check; structured extraction applies.

queries.query: What is the current wait time at the airport right now, and is the train a better option this evening?
queries.why: Real-time information; the archetypal case where recall fails.

queries.query: Refactor this Python function so it does not call the API twice.
queries.why: Near-miss: 'API' and 'call' overlap with the domain, but the task is a local code edit, not a lookup.

queries.query: Write a bash script that renames all .png files in this folder to .webp.
queries.why: Near-miss: could be done with a search for a tool, but the ask is authoring, not research.

queries.query: Explain what a hash map is and how it works.
queries.why: Near-miss: 'explain' overlaps with research, but this is stable textbook knowledge with nothing to look up.

queries.query: Add a retry with exponential backoff to the HTTP client in src/client.ts.
queries.why: Near-miss: mentions retry and timeout semantics, but the work is in the local repo.

queries.query: Find the definition of the parseConfig function in the project I am working on.
queries.why: Near-miss: 'find' plus a code identifier, but the target is the local codebase, use searching-codebases.

queries.query: Summarise the design doc I just pasted into the chat.
queries.why: Near-miss: summarising, but the source is in the conversation, so no search is needed.

queries.query: Draft an email to the team about the sprint retrospective.
queries.why: Near-miss: 'draft' is a research-adjacent task, but there is nothing to look up.

queries.query: What is the latest version of express in the node_modules folder of this project?
queries.why: Near-miss: 'latest version' is a live-lookup trigger, but the answer is in the local lockfile or package.json.

queries.query: Convert this CSV into a spreadsheet and colour the negative numbers red.
queries.why: Near-miss: file transformation, no external source needed.

queries.query: Review this pull request for correctness bugs.
queries.why: Near-miss: 'review' and 'bugs' overlap with the vulnerability theme, but the target is a local diff.
